source:
flowchart LR
    Lead -->|qualify| Inquiry
    Inquiry -->|Convert To Quotation| Quotation
    Inquiry -->|cancel inquiry| Cancelled[Cancelled inquiries]
    Inquiry -->|mark as lost| Lost
    Quotation -->|Convert To Order| Order
    Quotation -->|Regret To Quote| Regretted[Regretted to quote]
    Regretted -->|Disapprove regretted| Quotation
    Order -->|deliver| Delivered

flowchart LR
    Inquiry -->|convert| Offer
    Offer -->|Convert To Order Once The Client Signs| Order

flowchart LR
    O[Order] --> C[Orders confirmation and activation of every order line]
    C --> D[Delivered]
    D --> W[Warehouse detailed delivery work for each delivered item and its packaging]

flowchart LR
    Draft -->|Submit| R["In review"]
    R -->|Reject| Draft
    R -->|Approve| P[Published]

flowchart LR
    P[Potential] --> I[Inquiry]
    I --> O[Offer]
    O --> R[Order]
    P --> M[Missed]
    I --> CI[Cancelled Inquiries]
    I --> RO[Regretted to Offer]
    O --> RO
    O --> L[Lost]
    O --> CO[Cancelled Offer]
    R --> CA[Cancelled Orders]
    R --> RE[Rejected Orders]

flowchart LR
    A[Job created] --> B[Items added] --> C[Prices set] --> D[Quantities checked] --> E[Discounts applied] --> F[Taxes applied] --> G[Totals reviewed] --> H[Approved] --> I[Sent to client]

flowchart RL
    A[طلب عرض سعر] -->|إرسال| B[عرض السعر]
    B -->|موافقة| C[أمر الشراء]
    C --> D[فاتورة المبيعات]

flowchart LR
    subgraph Sales[Sales team]
      I[Inquiry] --> F[Offer]
    end
    subgraph Ops[Operations]
      R[Order] --> D[Delivery]
    end
    F -->|win| R

flowchart TD
    S[Start] --> Q{Is the stock enough?}
    Q -->|yes| P[Pick and pack]
    Q -->|no, order more| O[Order from the supplier]
    O --> P

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Leads
    Leads --> Inquiries: convert lead
    Leads --> Missed: mark missed
    Inquiries --> Quotes: convert inquiry
    Inquiries --> CancelledInquiries: cancel inquiry
    Inquiries --> LostInquiries: mark lost
    Inquiries --> DeletedInquiries: delete inquiry
    Quotes --> Orders: convert quote
    Quotes --> RegrettedQuotes: regret to quote
    Quotes --> CancelledQuotes: cancel quote
    Orders --> Delivered: deliver all active orders
    Orders --> CancelledOrders: cancel order
    Orders --> RejectedOrders: reject order

stateDiagram-v2
    Offer --> Order: convert eligible offer
    Order --> Delivered: deliver all active order work
    Order --> Offer: Back to offer
    Order --> Rejected: Reject order acceptance
    Order --> Cancelled: Cancelled order

stateDiagram-v2
    Quotation --> Order: quotation conversion
    Order --> AwaitingApproval: Request approval
    AwaitingApproval --> Approved: Approved
    Approved --> AwardSubmitted: Send the order award to the supplier
    Approved --> AwardSubmitted: Consider the award as submitted
    AwardSubmitted --> Received: receipt action

stateDiagram-v2
    state "Awaiting Approval" as sAwaiting
    state "Rejected Approval" as sRejected
    state "Due for Return" as sDue
    [*] --> sRequested
    sRequested --> sAwaiting: Request approval
    sAwaiting --> sApproved: Approve
    sAwaiting --> sRejected: Reject approval request
    sAwaiting --> sRequested: Cancel approval request
    sApproved --> sActive: Activate
    sActive --> sDue: Due for return
    sActive --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
    Draft --> GoodsReleasedForShipment: release goods
    GoodsReleasedForShipment --> ConsideredAsSentToPrincipal: consider as sent

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Active
    state Active {
        [*] --> Running
        Running --> Paused: Pause
        Paused --> Running: Resume
    }
    Active --> Closed: Close
    Closed --> [*]

stateDiagram-v2
    [*] --> Draft
    Draft --> Sent: send
    note right of Draft : Only the owner edits a draft
    note left of Sent
        A sent record is read only
    end note

flowchart LR
    A[WAITING FOR THE WAREHOUSE SUPERVISOR TO SIGN OFF] -->|FORWARD TO FINANCE FOR APPROVAL| B[PAYMENT RECEIVED AND VERIFIED BY FINANCE]
    B --> C([MMMM WWWW QQQQ])
    C --> D{WWW MMM?}
    D -->|YES| E((OK))
    D -->|NO WAY| A

stateDiagram-v2
    state "ORDER CONFIRMED BY THE CUSTOMER" as Confirmed
    state "PAYMENT RECEIVED AND VERIFIED" as Paid
    state "MAXIMUM WAIT WINDOW WAS MISSED" as Missed
    [*] --> Confirmed
    Confirmed --> Paid: PAYMENT RECORDED
    Confirmed --> Missed: WINDOW EXPIRED
    Paid --> [*]
